_what: USGS NAIP orthoimagery over UT Austin's CAMPUS bbox (see bake_entrances.py's CAMPUS const, read live by campusmeter.mjs). Real aerial photograph, not a basemap render — used as an independent ground truth for the paths check: it was not derived from OSM and does not share any pipeline with data/ground.geojson.
_license: USGS NAIP imagery is a U.S. federal government work, public domain.
note: bbox order is (west,south,east,north) i.e. (minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat), matching the exportImage bbox param. Row 0 of the image is the NORTH edge (maxlat); pixel (0,0) is the top-left = (minlon,maxlat).
